# Daily Report — 2026-08-18

## Task Completed
Added user preference management tools for the `sys_user_preference` table:
- **`get_user_preference`** — retrieve a preference by user and key name
- **`set_user_preference`** — create (POST) or update (PATCH) a preference; upserts automatically
- **`delete_user_preference`** — delete a preference; resolves the preference sys_id before deletion
- **`list_user_preferences`** — paginated list with optional user and name (substring) filters

All tools accept a `user_id` as either a 32-char hex sys_id or a `user_name`; the resolver short-circuits on hex IDs and performs a `sys_user` lookup otherwise. `set_user_preference` inspects for an existing record before deciding POST vs PATCH. New file: `src/servicenow_mcp/tools/user_preference_tools.py` (96% coverage). Registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
